narrative_summary: Implementing an automatic batch backup for a Zenon SCADA system that recovers production data after uncontrolled runtime termination.

kips.text: The BatchBackup plant model extends the SCADA system with automatic backup of batch production data in case of uncontrolled Zenon runtime termination
The backup procedure is triggered at runtime restart by evaluating three variables: B1_Batch.Start (remanent), nboBatchRuntimeStart, and nboBatchBackupStart
During batch production, archives S1 and E1 are automatically copied to the ExportArx runtime folder every 5 minutes to preserve batch data
The SE_StartBatchBackup script stops and restarts archives E1 and S1 and displays a popup notification (Pop_BatchBackup) to the operator
In the SCADA project, the StartBatchBackup script additionally starts all S1 and E1 start archives from subprojects
The BatchBackupExportArchives script copies E1.ARS, E1.ARX, S1.ARS, and S1.ARX files from the runtime data folder to the ExportArx export folder
The plant model can be imported via the ImportModelWizard or manually by adding 17 individual components under the Basic plant model
Wizard import must be performed on all subprojects before the SCADA project because the SaveRemanentDataAllProject script references subproject functions
Additional configuration requires setting B1_Batch.Start and B1_Batch.Start_Extern as remanent, creating the ExportArx folder, and modifying Autostart and Autostart_Delay scripts
The red-highlighted batch name after runtime restart is expected behavior caused by the uniqueness check detecting the name was already assigned at batch start
